_meta.name: English
_meta.note: Every visible string of the front door, the tool page /t/<id>/, the result page /r/<id>/ and the pricing page. {name} is filled in; a value that is an object holds one form per plural category of the language (Intl.PluralRules), chosen by {n}.

strings.lang.label: Language
strings.goal: The goal: Knos turns any research into a product billions of people use, in days, not years.
strings.foot.pages: Test money only, no customers yet.
strings.door.title: Knos: check a test file against a limit
strings.door.headline: What can you do with Knos?
strings.tool.title: Check a test file against a limit
strings.tool.line: For anyone who tests batteries, motors, parts or machines.
strings.work.checking: Checking your file on the Knos server
strings.work.waking: Waiting for Knos's server, which may be waking up
strings.work.still: Still waiting for the result from Knos's server
strings.err.empty: Your file is empty, so I have nothing to check yet. Choose a file or paste a table, then press Try it.
strings.err.limit: I need the limit as a number, such as 1.4, before I can check your file. Please type it, then press Try it.
strings.err.stopped: I stopped the check. Your file is still in the box, so you can change it or try again.
strings.err.reach: I could not reach Knos's server. It may be waking up. Your file is still in the box, so press Try again in a moment.
strings.err.none: I could not get a result from Knos's server just now. Your file is still in the box, so press Try again in a moment.

err.too_big.one: Your file is too big. The limit is {n} row. I kept your file in the box; try a shorter one.
err.too_big.other: Your file is too big. The limit is {n} rows. I kept your file in the box; try a shorter one.

err.too_long.one: This took too long and was stopped. Try a smaller file. I stopped it after {n} second and kept your file in the box.
err.too_long.other: This took too long and was stopped. Try a smaller file. I stopped it after {n} seconds and kept your file in the box.

strings.err.not_ready: I cannot check files yet, because the program for this tool has not passed the test that decides it works. Please try again later.
strings.err.bad: I could not read your file with these settings. Check the column and the limit; your file is still in the box.
strings.res.private: Only people with this link can see it.
strings.res.shown_by: Checked by a test of 7 files with known answers.
strings.res.by_hand: I could not copy the link. Here it is, to copy by hand:
strings.res.count_q: Count my visits to help improve Knos?
strings.chart.label: Chart of the values with the limit
strings.chart.label_fail: Chart of the values with the limit, the first failing row marked
strings.rs.fail_above: Failed at row {r}: {value} is not above {limit}.
strings.rs.fail_below: Failed at row {r}: {value} is not below {limit}.

rs.before.one: It passed for the {n} rows before that.
rs.before.other: It passed for the {n} rows before that.

rs.skipped.one: {n} rows were skipped because they are not numbers.
rs.skipped.other: {n} rows were skipped because they are not numbers.

pay.headline.one: {n} more run for {price} in test money
pay.headline.other: {n} more runs for {price} in test money

strings.pay.line: Today this is test money. Nothing is charged.

pay.confirm.one: This records a {price} test payment for {n} more run. Nothing is charged.
pay.confirm.other: This records a {price} test payment for {n} more runs. Nothing is charged.

strings.pay.error: I could not record the test payment just now. Nothing was charged. Press Yes, record it again in a moment.
strings.a.tool.get: One sentence that names the first row breaking your limit, or says every row passed, with a chart and a link to it.
strings.a.tool.next: Press Try it to check the sample. For your own file, press Use my data and fill in its three boxes.
strings.a.res.get: This result: the sentence and chart above, kept at this page's link. A sample result is public; one from your own file is not listed.
strings.a.res.next: Press Copy link to share this result, or Use my data to check your own file.

a.pay.one: Sample runs are free. Own files: {free} free runs a day, then {price} in test money for {n} more, paid by you after you confirm.
a.pay.other: Sample runs are free. Own files: {free} free runs a day, then {price} in test money for {n} more, paid by you after you confirm.

a.why_released.one: A public test of 7 files with known answers passed before release; Knos's checker ran it. Not tested: files over {n} row.
a.why_released.other: A public test of 7 files with known answers passed before release; Knos's checker ran it. Not tested: files over {n} rows.

a.why_unreleased.one: A public test of 7 files with known answers must pass before release; Knos's checker runs it. Not tested: files over {n} row.
a.why_unreleased.other: A public test of 7 files with known answers must pass before release; Knos's checker runs it. Not tested: files over {n} rows.

strings.a.tool.who: Knos runs this tool and its test. No date is set for the next update. To challenge a result, open an issue on GitHub.

a.price.get.one: {n} more run of the tool on your own files, once your {free} free runs of the day are used.
a.price.get.other: {n} more runs of the tool on your own files, once your {free} free runs of the day are used.

strings.a.price.next: Use the tool. When your free runs end, it shows Pay with test money; press it, then confirm.

a.price.pay.one: {price} in test money for {n} run, paid by you, once, after you confirm. Nothing is charged today; no card or account is asked.
a.price.pay.other: {price} in test money for {n} runs, paid by you, once, after you confirm. Nothing is charged today; no card or account is asked.

strings.a.price.why: No study set these prices. They are starting values to be tested, each marked so in the public pricing file.
strings.a.price.who: Knos sets these prices and records each test payment on its own server. To challenge one, open an issue on GitHub.

fold.sample_made_up.one: The sample is made up: a straight line from {first} to {last} over {n} cycle, because NASA's page offers no download from a nasa.gov address. Its limit, {limit}, is the end-of-life rule on NASA's battery data page.
fold.sample_made_up.other: The sample is made up: a straight line from {first} to {last} over {n} cycles, because NASA's page offers no download from a nasa.gov address. Its limit, {limit}, is the end-of-life rule on NASA's battery data page.

strings.fold.sample_nasa: Sample data: NASA Prognostics Center of Excellence.
strings.fold.not_do: It checks one column against one limit. It does not judge whether the limit is the right one. A row whose value is not a number is skipped and counted.
strings.fold.file: Your file goes to Knos's server, which checks it and keeps it with its result page, so the link works. A sample result can be opened by anyone. Your own file can be opened only by people who have its link, and it is never listed. The server keeps results only until it is next rebuilt, so a link can stop working.

fold.test.one: The test that showed it works checks six made-up files with known answers and the sample. It did not cover files longer than {n} row, or files separated by anything other than commas. The test is public.
fold.test.other: The test that showed it works checks six made-up files with known answers and the sample. It did not cover files longer than {n} rows, or files separated by anything other than commas. The test is public.

fold.price.one: Runs on the sample are free. Runs on your own file: {free} free a day, then {n} more run for {price} in test money. Today nothing is charged.
fold.price.other: Runs on the sample are free. Runs on your own file: {free} free a day, then {n} more runs for {price} in test money. Today nothing is charged.

strings.fold.built_released: Who built it: AI helpers wrote the program through Knos, and it was released only when that test passed. The public record.
strings.fold.built_unreleased: Who built it: AI helpers write the program through Knos, and it is released only when that test passes. It has not been released yet.
strings.fold.embed_label: One line of HTML to copy onto your site
strings.fold.mt: This page was machine translated and has not been reviewed by a native speaker.
strings.fold.original: The program's own words, in English: {text}
strings.embed.title: A Knos result

strings.ask.ph: A question or a paper's link
strings.ask.cost: Checking one paper by hand: {low} to {high} (Perignon, citing Colliard).
strings.ask.closest: Closest proved claim (not your exact question):
strings.ask.proved: Proved by a test locked before any work started.
strings.ask.locked: Its test is locked before any work starts.
strings.ask.behind: {amount} test USDC from people outside Knos this week

ask.none_line.one: Knos has proved {n} claim on NEAR testnet; none is about "{q}". Ask about one of them, or enter a paper's link.
ask.none_line.other: Knos has proved {n} claims on NEAR testnet; none is about "{q}". Ask about one of them, or enter a paper's link.

strings.ask.no_answer: Knos's server did not answer, so the paper was not read. It may be waking up.
strings.ask.cannot: Knos cannot prove this paper yet
strings.ask.person: Today a person checks it: {checker}. Price: {price_text}. Time: {time}.
strings.price.title: Knos pricing
strings.price.sample_free: Runs on the sample are free.

price.free_day.one: {n} free a day, in each browser
price.free_day.other: {n} free a day, in each browser

strings.price.f1: No study gave these prices. They are starting values to be tested, and each one is in the pricing file with that mark.
strings.price.f2: When your free runs are used up, the tool shows one screen with the price. Pressing Pay with test money records a test payment on Knos's own server. No card and no account are needed.
strings.price.f3: The fees for checking a paper's claim are on a page of their own.
